WP7: T&C booklet: "Maximum Capping per month on NeuCoins ... Grocery, Insurance, Utility, Telecom and cable" - the cap covers all NeuCoins in the category, but the record tied it only to the extra-5% Tata Neu app rule (info). Base-rate rule carrying the cap; priority 15 (ahead of the 5% partner rule, as on the HDFC Infinity record) so a capped category never pays the partner rate uncapped (H2: may under-state at partner grocery brands).

WP7: T&C 11.3(b)/(d): value back on "spends on Tata Neu App/Website and partner Tata Brands" (Air India & AI Express, Big Basket, Tata Cliq, Taj, Tata 1MG, Titan & Tanishq, Croma, Westside, Qmin). One list feeds the partner rule and its UPI carve-out, so they always cover the same merchants.
WP7: Tata Neu is now in the brand list itself (it was only implied by the channel text).
WP7: Restates the partner brands (Tata Neu app/website and partner brands); made the rule info.

WP7: T&C 11.3(e): "1.5% Value back as NeuCoins on other spends, including UPI transactions (applicable on spends on RuPay Variant)". Read as: UPI spends earn the 1.5% UPI/other rate, including at partner brands (the Plus SBI booklet says so explicitly); the 5% partner rate is not applied on UPI.

WP7: D25e: T&C 11.4(a) excludes "Merchant EMI - Flexipay" (Infinity) / "Flexipay" (Plus), and 11.6(e) forfeits NeuCoins when "The transaction on which NeuCoins were accrued, got converted to EMI". Rail-EMI exclusion on all spend, as on Millennia (the record's category emi AND rail emi row missed EMI in other categories).
WP7: D25d: T&C 11.4 lists MCC 7349 with rent (6513) and education MCCs 5111, 5192, 5942, 5943, 5947, 8351 besides 8211-8299; the record carried only part of each list.
WP7: D25d: T&C 11.4(g) "Gaming ( 5816, 7993, 7994)"; the record had no gaming exclusion.
WP7: D25d: T&C 11.4(a) "cash advances"; the record had no cash-advance exclusion.
